dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Dougie was recently surrendered to the care center due to a bite incident that occurred in the home. The son states they were bitten on the right foot after reaching for their flip flops on November 12. Dougie bit and broke skin. This isn't the first time they were bitten. However, they state this was the first bite that broke skin. During his medical exam, Dougie was observed to be loose and wiggly. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an adult only home.
dog.name: Dougie
